description: Results of a search query against an OpenSearch index. The set of populated fields is governed by the request's responseParts: hits and offset are populated by default; the remaining fields are populated only when the corresponding SearchQueryPart is requested.

hits.description: Matching documents. Populated by default (or whenever SearchQueryPart.HITS is requested).

totalHits.description: The total number of matching documents. Populated when SearchQueryPart.TOTAL_HITS is requested.

selectColumns.description: The columns represented in each hit's fields, in SELECT-clause order. Populated when SearchQueryPart.SELECT_COLUMNS is requested. When SearchQuery.returnFields is non-empty, this is the subset of columns matching those names.

facets.description: Facet aggregation results. Populated when SearchQueryPart.FACETS is requested. Autocomplete never produces facets regardless of this part being requested.

aggregationResults.description: The raw OpenSearch aggregation results as a JSON string (a map of aggregation name to its result), populated when the request supplied the opaque aggregations object AND SearchQueryPart.FACETS is requested. Mutually exclusive with facets: the terms-facet path populates facets, the opaque-aggregations path populates this. Returned as an opaque JSON string for the caller to parse — its shape mirrors the aggregation types in the request.

nextSearchAfter.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page. When SearchQueryPart.HITS is requested and a full page (limit hits) was returned, this carries the cursor of the last returned hit; pass it back verbatim as the next request's searchAfter to continue. Null when there are no further pages (fewer than limit hits were returned).

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset echoed from the request. Always populated.
